differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with normal/high RBC count in an Asian adult fits hereditary hemoglobinopathy.

differential.name: Iron‑deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Common cause of microcytosis; possible chronic GI blood loss in a patient with obesity and NSAID use for gout.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic inflammation from gout, sinusitis, and obesity can suppress erythropoiesis.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome (obesity, prediabetes, dyslipidemia) often yields mildly elevated alkaline phosphatase.

differential.name: Gout (hyperuricemia)
differential.rationale: Established gout diagnosis; may contribute to renal urate handling and mild potassium elevation.
